long long memo[17][2000000];
vector<long long> A(17);

long long dfs(int ind, long long n) {
    if (ind == 0) return n == 0 ? 0 : LLONG_MAX;
    if (n < 0) n = -n;

    long long m = n / A[ind];

    long long res2 = dfs(ind-1, n - (m+1) * A[ind]) + (m + 1) * ind;
    long long res = min(res1, res2);
    
    memo[ind][n] = res;
    return res;
}

    ios::sync_with_stdio(0); cin.tie(0);
    long long n;

    for(int i = 1; i <= 16; ++i)
        A[i] = A[i-1] * 10 + 1;
    
    for(int i = 0; i <= 16; ++i)
        for(int j = 0; j < 2000000; ++j)
            memo[i][j] = -1;
    
    cout << dfs(16, n) << '\n';
